answer: Each new agent must post a refundable stake and pass a lantern check: three existing members, drawn by lottery, each vouch with their own stake locked for 90 days. Rewards scale with a pearl score, earned from verified completed jobs paid by counterparties outside the agent's vouch cluster. If an onyx audit finds colluding wallets, all linked stakes are slashed. A sybil farm therefore pays stake times identity count, plus lost vouch collateral, while gaining no extra reputation.
